title: Legacy Strategy to Break the局
next_chapter_hook: The moment Ling Yuan's cultivation was destroyed, a sinister curve formed at the corner of his lips—that smile seemed to say, the real chess game has just begun.

text.content: In the Back Mountain of Tianqing Sect, the cold wind was biting. Chen Ji read the yellowed secret letter three times over, and each time, the shock in his heart deepened. His father's handwriting was bold and powerful, yet hiding an indescribable desolation: 'My son, if you can read this letter, it means the Five Elders' remnants have not yet been completely eliminated. Following the instructions in this letter, you can find irrefutable evidence of their collusion with the Eye of Heavenly天道 at the abandoned alchemy room in the southeast corner of the sect's Forbidden Grounds.' Chen Ji gripped the letter tightly, his knuckles white. Eighteen years—his father had calculated everything precisely eighteen years ago.

Chen Ji tucked away the secret letter and vanished into the night. In the southeast corner of the sect's Forbidden Grounds, the abandoned alchemy room had been overgrown with weeds for years, the talismans on its walls dim and lifeless. However, when Chen Ji activated the opening incantation recorded in the letter using a special technique, the entire floor of the alchemy room slowly cracked open, revealing a deep, dark passage. From the end of the passage came whispers. Chen Ji's lips curved slightly—his father's backup plan had never disappointed him.

Deep within the passage, a spacious stone chamber blazed with lights. Three elders sat around a black stone table, which was covered with various spirit materials and formation boards. Their auras were obscure, and they were unmistakably in the late Golden Core stage. Although the 'Five Elders' had been gravely injured by Chen Xuan back then, they had not completely perished; instead, they had hidden in this sunless underground to prolong their dying breaths. One of the gray-robed elders suddenly looked up, and a flicker of alertness flashed in his clouded eyes: 'Who goes there!' The stone door burst open, and Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, a hint of nonchalant smile at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: The three seniors truly know how to hide well. If not for my father's testament letter, I, Chen Ji, would never have found this treasure ground. Chen Ji slowly walked into the stone chamber, his gaze sweeping across the three faces: 'Hiding for eighteen years, have the five seniors been living comfortably?'

The gray-robed elder jumped to his feet, killing intent radiating from his eyes: 'Chen Xuan's孽种! Your father destroyed my foundation back then, and now you've come to deliver yourself to death?' Chen Ji shook his head, took out a jade slip from his sleeve, and tossed it onto the table carelessly: 'Deliver myself to death? The senior seems to have misunderstood something. Chen Ji came today to give the seniors a grand gift—the correspondence letters secretly communicating with the Eye of Heavenly天道, and the sacrifice list built on pile of corpses.'

choice.prompt: Faced with the three cornered remnants of the Five Elders, what method should Chen Ji adopt to settle accounts?

choices.description: Expose the Five Elders' crimes to the world, exposing their ugly face of selling the sect for personal gain before all sect disciples, letting them be ruined in the public eye.
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's own strength, attracting attention from more forces
choices.visible_reward: Reputation soars, the Five Elders are utterly ruined, never to翻身
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may take the opportunity to intervene
choices.process_label: 当着宗门弟子的面清算

dialogue.content: Since the seniors enjoy hiding in the dark, then let me send you to an even brighter place—how about the sect's Council Hall? Let everyone in the sect see what shameful deeds the Five Elders committed back then!

choices.description: Quietly and thoroughly erase the three without leaving any trace, so as not to dirty one's own hands, and to prevent those behind the scenes from noticing.
choices.visible_reward: Silently eliminate the threat, buying time for subsequent arrangements

dialogue.content: Forget it, what's the point of wasting breath on the dead? I, Chen Ji, have always preferred simplicity. Since the seniors chose to hide, then hide forever—hide in the coffin.

text.content: The gray-robed elder's face changed drastically, and he slammed the table: 'Ridiculous nonsense! We have never had any dealings with the Eye of Heavenly天道, you young whelp, slanderer!' However, his voice was trembling slightly, and his gaze involuntarily drifted toward a black box in the corner of the stone chamber. Chen Ji followed his gaze and suddenly smiled: 'Why so nervous, senior? The contents of that box intrigue me greatly.' Before he finished speaking, his figure flashed, and he directly rushed toward that black box.

dialogue.content: 'You dare, young fool!' The gray-robed elder roared in rage, and a sharp sword qi pierced through the air. However, Chen Ji seemed to have anticipated this long ago, sidestepping it while snatching the black box into his palm. The moment the box lid was lifted, a strong bloody stench rushed to meet him. Lying in the box was a completely black token, with the characters 'Heavenly天道' carved on the front, and on the back was a dense list of names—each name followed by specific dates and locations, all records of disciples who had disappeared in the past twenty years.

text.content: 'I have a question for the seniors.' Chen Ji raised the token, letting the candlelight illuminate those shocking names: 'In the past twenty years, a total of 173 disciples have disappeared from Tianqing Sect, including 31 Inner Sect disciples and 7 core disciples. All of them were sacrificed to that Eye of Heavenly天道, correct?' The gray-robed elder's face turned ashen, while the other two elders showed fear and unconsciously stepped back. The atmosphere in the stone chamber suddenly solidified, as if even the air was frozen by this invisible killing intent.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji! Don't push us too far!' The gray-robed elder shouted with a harsh voice: 'You think a Foundation Building废物 can do anything to us? Your father was so impressive back then, yet wasn't he still schemed against by us and ended up with身死道消!' His words were full of resentment: 'You're just a lucky dog屎运的孽种, and you dare act so arrogantly before me?'

choice.prompt: Faced with the gray-robed elder's bluster, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Without wasting more words, crush with absolute strength, letting the other party understand what true disparity means in despair. Use actions to teach him what 'playing pig to eat tiger' means.
choices.visible_reward: Instantly kill late Golden Core stage, shocking the entire scene

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head and suddenly raised his right hand. In that instant, a suffocating pressure poured out from within him, as if a sleeping dragon had finally opened its eyes. The gray-robed elder's smile instantly froze on his face, his pupils contracting violently: 'This... impossible! How can you...' Before he finished, an invisible force had already locked his throat, lifting his entire body up.

choices.description: First let the other party taste the滋味 of being crushed by words, crushing his pride piece by piece word by word, letting him die with endless humiliation.
choices.visible_reward: Psychological double strike, making the enemy lose all face

dialogue.content: 废物? I would like to ask, senior, what was your feeling when my father crippled half your cultivation with a single sword back then?' Chen Ji's voice was unhurried, each word was heartpiercing: 'Hiding in this sunless place for eighteen years, not even daring to look me in the eye—who is really the废物?'

text.content: Just then, a violent spiritual energy fluctuation suddenly came from outside the stone chamber. An old yet dignified voice penetrated the stone wall: 'Chen Ji, you have great audacity! How dare you trespass the sect's Forbidden Grounds and harm fellow seniors!' The stone door shattered, and a figure swept into the stone chamber. It was Ling Yuan, the old sect master of Tianqing Sect. His gaze swept across the stone chamber like lightning, his face gloomy enough to drip water: 'Hand over that evidence, and I may spare you considering your youth and ignorance, letting you live.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked at Ling Yuan and suddenly smiled. That smile carried a hint of playfulness, a hint of sarcasm, and an indecipherable depth: 'Ling Sect Master arrives most opportunely. I was just wondering, how did the Sect Master know I was here? Could it be... the Sect Master has always been in contact with these seniors?' Ling Yuan's face changed slightly, then quickly returned to calm: 'Nonsense! As the Sect Master, I naturally have the duty to maintain sect peace. Trespassing the Forbidden Grounds is a capital offense!'

text.content: Is that so?' Chen Ji took out a jade slip from his bosom and casually tossed it into the air. The jade slip exploded mid-air, and countless light images projected onto the four walls of the stone chamber—those were video recordings, and the scenes clearly showed secret meetings between Ling Yuan and these three elders! Ling Yuan's face instantly turned deathly pale, the recordings were damningly clear, even the Sect Master's token hanging from his waist was clearly visible. 'Ling Sect Master, I have another question—I wonder how many deals have you made with the Eye of Heavenly天道?'

Ling Yuan's entire body shuddered violently, his eyes flashing a complex mix of fear and hatred. The next instant, he suddenly erupted, a stunning sword light directly targeting Chen Ji's vital point: 'You little beast! You must die here today!' However, facing this fierce sword strike that could destroy mountains and split rocks, Chen Ji merely lightly raised two fingers, firmly clamping the sword light between them. He looked at Ling Yuan, his eyes showing no emotional fluctuation whatsoever: 'Ling Sect Master, the force of your sword strike is not even one-tenth of the casual strike my father used when he crippled you back then.'

Ling Yuan's pupils contracted violently as he desperately mobilized the spiritual energy in his body, yet those two fingers remained immovable like two mountains. 'No... impossible! How can you...' Chen Ji smiled faintly, lightly flicked his fingers, and that long sword broke with a snap. The sword fragments, carried by spiritual energy, shot out like a violent rain, instantly piercing through Ling Yuan's dantian. Ling Yuan let out a miserable scream, his body stumbled backward, blood gushed profusely from his dantian. He looked up at Chen Ji, his eyes filled with disbelief and deep-seated hatred.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan has had his cultivation destroyed. How should Chen Ji deal with these four people?

choices.description: Escort the four to the sect's Council Hall, publicly trial them before all disciples, letting the Five Elders' crimes be exposed to the world while also deterring others with ulterior motives.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation surges massively, becoming famous in one battle

text.content: Chen Ji waved his hand, and a spiritual light bound all four of them. He looked around, his gaze cold as frost: 'Since they are sect traitors, naturally the entire sect should see their ugly faces clearly. Come on, everyone, accompany me to the Council Hall.'

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan has already been crippled, there's no need to keep him alive. Only the dead can keep secrets, which also completely eliminates future troubles.
choices.visible_cost: Loses the opportunity for public exposure
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate the roots, leave no hidden dangers

dialogue.content: Chen Ji withdrew his fingers, his gaze terrifyingly calm: 'Ling Sect Master, you've kept company with these three seniors for many years, surely you have deep feelings. I shall send you on your way, so you can look after each other on the road to the Yellow Springs.' Before his words even finished, a sharp sword qi had already pierced through Ling Yuan's chest.

text.content: In the instant the sword qi pierced through Ling Yuan's chest, his body suddenly shuddered violently. Blood dripped down the corner of his mouth, yet a strange smile slowly spread across his face. That smile held no pain, but rather a chilling certainty. 'Chen Ji... you think... you've won?' His voice was hoarse and broken, every word seeming to be挤出 from between his teeth: 'The Eye of Heavenly天道... has been watching you for a long time... you're nothing but... another piece on the board...'

As the words fell, Ling Yuan's body suddenly trembled violently. A black light shot out from his brow center, instantly tearing through the虚空 and disappearing to the end of the heavens. Chen Ji's gaze slightly hardened—that black light's aura was all too familiar to him—the distinctive fluctuation of the Eye of Heavenly天道. Ling Yuan's depleted body collapsed softly, all breath gone. And the three elders were even more ashen-faced, one of them trembling: 'It's over... all over... the Holy Lord will not spare us...'

Chen Ji stood in place, looking at Ling Yuan's死不瞑目的 corpse, his brow slightly furrowed. What his father wrote in the secret letter was correct—this was still far from over. Ling Yuan's words before death, and that black light flying toward the虚空, both indicated that the Eye of Heavenly天道's scheme was even more profound than he had imagined. He slowly turned around, his gaze sweeping across the three elders collapsed on the ground, his voice平静得 without a trace of波纹: 'I, Chen Ji, still have many questions to ask the seniors. Come on, let's go somewhere we can have a proper conversation.' Outside the stone chamber, the sky had begun to lighten slightly, a new day was about to arrive. And this storm destined for Tianqing Sect was only just beginning.
